patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections with alternating dark blue and lighter dark blue backgrounds, using a centered max-width container for text and imagery.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, contrasting with lighter-weight body text and occasional uppercase labels for feature categories.
A deep, sophisticated dark blue serves as the primary background, paired with white text for high contrast, and a vibrant blue for calls-to-action and interactive elements.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent background to a solid dark blue with reduced height and padding as the user scrolls down the page, remaining sticky at the top.
Feature sections consistently pair a concise heading and descriptive text with large, detailed product screenshots or diagrams to visually explain complex functionalities.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that changes its visual properties (background color, height, padding) via a CSS class or JavaScript trigger once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Content sections are designed to be full-width, with inner content constrained to a maximum width and horizontally centered, providing a structured and readable layout.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with generous line height, complemented by lighter-weight body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (mostly sharp corners, with CTAs having a slight, soft curve).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (comfortable padding around sections and within content blocks, creating an airy feel in the hero and a structured density in feature grids).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, sophisticated dark blue palette combined with a clean, modern sans-serif typeface creates an authoritative and technically proficient aesthetic. It effectively leverages large, detailed product screenshots within a structured layout to clearly communicate complex incident management features.
